name: 候補の選択に応じて詳細操作を開く二面パネル
prompt:
Create one Japanese localized, light-theme two-pane stock command menu on a clean white canvas. Use the original source crop aspect ratio, approximately 1143:405 (2.82:1).

Reference priority:
1) The original component crop controls the split-pane geometry, selected first row, overlapping details panel, five-row list, action order, and shortcut-key rail. Ignore the dark onboarding dimmer and all unrelated page context.
2) The Japanese preview controls the light surface, exact Japanese copy, subdued mint selection, green line icons, and panel styling. Treat it as the appearance and localization target.

Show a left stock list with exactly five rows in this order, each with a small circular company mark and Japanese name: “アップル” (selected), “テスラ”, “マイクロソフト”, “アイビーエム”, “ナイキ”. The selected first row has a thin #168A64 outline and very pale mint fill. Keep the remaining rows neutral with muted gray text and even vertical spacing.

On the right, show one white rounded-rectangle details panel with a very light gray outline. Its header has a small Apple-like circular mark and “アップル”. Under a thin divider, show the muted subtitle “この銘柄について”. Then show five compact action rows in this exact order: “銘柄を分析”, “業績予想”, “財務情報”, “内部取引”, “決算”. Highlight the first action with a pale mint background. Use simple thin green line icons matching the preview: magnifying glass, analyst/person chart, financial document, location/insider marker, and clock. Put a small outlined shortcut keycap at the far right of each row with “X”, “A”, “F”, “i”, and “E” respectively; keep the “i” lowercase.

Use the Japanese preview’s clean Meiryo-like sans-serif, dark charcoal labels, muted gray subtitle, restrained green accents, compact line icons, thin borders, and generous white space. Preserve the original left-list/right-panel hierarchy and keep all labels fully visible and legible. Keep all five company marks small and circular; do not add large brand artwork.

Do not add a dark overlay, onboarding title, explanatory copy, extra rows, website header, unrelated graphics, shadows, extra action labels, or watermark. Do not blur, truncate, or misspell any Japanese copy.
reviewNotes: Japanese two-pane stock command panel; visually reviewed for layout, text, shortcut labels and clipping. Company marks are generated raster approximations.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
